registered_rule: On HKairport01 only, scan start offsets 0,20,40,... seconds relative to first RGB timestamp. Choose the earliest 60-second window for which at least 80% of its 240 mapping frames have cruise speed >=1.0 m/s and RTK horizontal max pairwise displacement is >=30m. Tie and timestamp rules remain unchanged.
sequence_transfer: Apply this same relative window to AMtown01 and AMvalley01; metadata gates only, no window reselection.
